name: mcportal
description: Your personal, agent-composed reading room: portals onto Hacker News, GitHub and any RSS feed, arranged the way you ask, with reader view and no ads.
long_description: MCPortal is your reading room inside your agent. Open it to see portals onto the sources you follow (any site with a feed, Hacker News, GitHub, documentation sites), arranged the way you ask. Read articles and docs without the clutter, save links, clip things from the conversation, and import or export your subscriptions. This bundle runs MCPortal on your computer: your room lives in ~/.mcportal and nothing is sent anywhere but the sites you follow.

tools.name: open_room
tools.description: Open the user's MCPortal room: portals onto the sources they follow, in their layout, with what's new in each and each portal's id.

tools.name: build_room
tools.description: Set up the user's room from up to 4 starter packs (ids from open_room's setup).

tools.name: arrange_room
tools.description: Change the room's layout: move portals (to a column, 1 = left; one past the last makes a new column), set column widths, retitle portals or change their settings, rename the room, or switch layout or how stories open.

tools.name: remove_portal
tools.description: Remove portals from the user's room, only ones they asked to remove (by id or title; open_room lists them).

tools.name: list_new_items
tools.description: What the user hasn't seen yet across their room (or the portals named), each with a ref, plus what MCPortal knows of their taste.

tools.name: show_highlights
tools.description: Show your picks from list_new_items, best first, as a highlights card: each item's ref and a one-line reason it's worth the user's time.

tools.name: read_source
tools.description: Fetch the latest items from one source (Hacker News, a feed, GitHub) without changing the room: for 'what's new on…' or previewing a feed before adding it.

tools.name: find_source
tools.description: Find what MCPortal can show for something the user wants to follow, test-load it and preview it; add a candidate with add_portal.

tools.name: add_portal
tools.description: Add one portal to the user's room from a find_source candidate (its source and config).

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Describe the source types MCPortal can show in a portal and the settings each accepts.

tools.name: import_opml
tools.description: Import the user's subscriptions from another feed reader: pass their OPML export's text.

tools.name: read_article
tools.description: Open a web page in reader view: clean title, byline and text, shown as a card.

tools.name: save_item
tools.description: Save a link for later (a bookmark), or change the title or note of one already saved.

tools.name: remove_saved
tools.description: Remove one link from the user's saved items.

tools.name: pin_portal
tools.description: Show results from another of the user's tools (Jira, Slack, Drive, a database, …) as a portal in their room: you fetch them with that tool and pass short items here; MCPortal never contacts it.

tools.name: open_docs
tools.description: Open a docs site in the docs viewer (shown as a card) and get its contents: sections and pages, with links.

tools.name: read_doc_page
tools.description: Read one page of a docs site as clean text (headings, code, tables, callouts), with its section and the previous and next pages.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Find pages of a docs site by title and section, and on Sphinx sites functions and classes by name ('str.split'); not full text.

tools.name: open_handoff
tools.description: Open a page the user sent here from MCPortal's reader (they say "Open MCPortal handoff k7q2xm"): shows it as a card where they were reading, with any passage they selected, and gives you its text.

tools.name: clip
tools.description: Keep something from this chat (or an article) in the user's clips, only when they ask to clip or keep it; a link to read later is save_item.

tools.name: search_clips
tools.description: Find the user's clips by words, kind or tag, for things from earlier chats ('that table we made about…').

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: Show one of the user's clips in full, as a card in the conversation ("show me that table").

tools.name: update_clip
tools.description: Change a clip's title, note or tags.

tools.name: delete_clip
tools.description: Delete one of the user's clips.

tools.name: export_data
tools.description: Give the user a copy of their data: everything (mcportal), saved items as bookmarks, clips as Markdown, or sources as OPML.

tools.name: import_portal
tools.description: Add an MCPortal export to the user's room: portals they don't have, saved items and clips; nothing is removed or moved.

tools.name: account_settings
tools.description: Link to the user's account page, where they sign in with GitHub to download everything or delete their account.

tools.name: list_reading
tools.description: What the user was reading: pages they opened and haven't finished, most recent first ('what was I in the middle of?').
